rules: Use exact named concepts, not broad body-region ancestors.
Deduplicate each FJ within a unit: isa and partof tables repeat some relationships.
No source FJ may be copied wholesale into multiple model units. Shared FJs require a real geometric partition.
Trapezius, deltoid, triceps, biceps and gastrocnemius have separate named source heads/parts; no whole-muscle duplication needed.
FJ...M is used only as a mirror-side fallback when sided ontology names are absent. Explicit sided concepts take precedence.
